_doc: Banque de sujets. rendu = gemini (image générée) ou carte (gabarit HTML aux couleurs de la marque). refs : images de référence données à Gemini ('portrait' = un vrai rendu du moteur). Les textes posés sur les cartes sont écrits ici, jamais inventés par l'IA. Écrans du générateur : captures réelles du site (apps/web/public/visuels/generateur). Toutes les références visuelles viennent des visuels du site (apps/web/public/visuels), jamais des plans de fabrication.

sujets.brief: Gros plan artistique sur le fil et les clous : la matière du produit.
sujets.prompt: Extreme macro photograph of thin black threads stretched taut between polished brass nails on a matte white wooden board. Shallow depth of field, a few threads crossing in sharp focus, soft warm side light, elegant and minimal.

sujets.brief: De près ce ne sont que des lignes, de loin un visage apparaît : la magie du string art.
sujets.prompt: Split composition: on the left half, an extreme close-up of the black thread lines and brass nails of the reference string art portrait, looking abstract; on the right half, the same circular string art portrait seen from a distance, hanging on a white wall, the face clearly readable. Keep the portrait exactly as in the reference image.

sujets.brief: Le fil noir rencontre l'architecture blanche de la Casbah d'Alger.
sujets.prompt: Artistic photograph of a whitewashed alley in the Casbah of Algiers at golden hour, a single long black thread elegantly stretched across the alley between two old brass nails in the walls, poetic and minimal, soft shadows.

sujets.brief: Le fil comme une ligne d'horizon dans le désert algérien.
sujets.prompt: Minimalist fine-art photograph of the Algerian Sahara dunes at dawn, a white square board with a ring of brass nails standing on the sand, a few black threads crossing it, long shadows, warm pastel sky, vast negative space.

sujets.brief: Géométrie du zellige et géométrie du fil : un art de lignes, comme notre patrimoine.
sujets.prompt: Top-down flat lay: a traditional Algerian green and white zellige tile pattern on the left, a white board with a circle of brass nails and intersecting black thread lines forming geometric patterns on the right, echoing the zellige geometry. Soft daylight, crisp details.

sujets.brief: Une bobine, un fil continu, des milliers de passages.
sujets.prompt: Still life of a spool of black thread on a light wooden unwinder, the thread unwinding in a long graceful curve across a white table toward a board with brass nails, dramatic warm window light, dust particles in the light beam.

sujets.brief: Hommage au haïk algérois, portrait en fil réalisé par notre moteur.
sujets.prompt: The reference circular string art portrait displayed on an easel in a bright traditional Algiers house courtyard with white arches and blue shutters, a folded white haik fabric draped next to it. Keep the portrait exactly as in the reference image.

sujets.brief: Le Hoggar et ses gardiens, en fil tendu.
sujets.prompt: The reference circular string art portrait leaning against a sandstone rock in the Hoggar mountains at sunset, an indigo fabric and a silver Tuareg cross pendant on the rock beside it. Keep the portrait exactly as in the reference image.

sujets.brief: Le geste : la main qui tend le fil d'un clou à l'autre.
sujets.prompt: Close-up of a woman's hand with henna patterns guiding a black thread around a brass nail on a white board, other threads forming a dense web in the background, soft focus, warm natural light.

sujets.brief: Le déballage du kit : tout est dans la boîte.
sujets.prompt: Top-down flat lay of an opened kraft cardboard gift box like the reference, revealing a white square board with a ring of brass nails, a spool of black thread on a small wooden unwinder, a wooden phone stand and a small message card. Light wooden table, soft morning light, a sprig of jasmine.

sujets.brief: Le kit prêt à offrir.
sujets.prompt: A kraft cardboard gift box like the reference, wrapped with an emerald green satin ribbon, on a marble table in an elegant Algerian living room, a glass of mint tea and a small bouquet beside it, warm golden light, cosy and premium.

sujets.brief: La boîte se transforme en chevalet pour tisser confortablement.
sujets.prompt: The kraft box from the reference unfolded into a stand holding a white board with a circle of brass nails at an angle on a desk, a smartphone on a small wooden stand next to it, a spool of black thread, bright and tidy workspace.

sujets.brief: Le dévidoir en bois : le fil se déroule sans s'emmêler.
sujets.prompt: Product photograph of a spool of black thread mounted on a light birch wood unwinder like the reference, on a white surface with soft shadow, a few meters of thread flowing neatly, premium studio lighting.

sujets.brief: Ce que contient le kit : planche, clous posés, fil, support, code.
sujets.prompt: Knolling arrangement on a pale plaster background: a white square board with brass nails in a circle, a spool of black thread on a wooden unwinder, a wooden phone stand, a small instruction booklet, a small card with a code, all neatly aligned with equal spacing, soft even light.

sujets.brief: Reçu à la maison, payé à la livraison.
sujets.prompt: At the door of an Algerian apartment, a smiling young woman receives a kraft cardboard box like the reference from a delivery man (only his arms visible), natural daylight, authentic and warm.

sujets.brief: Un moment pour soi : le kit installé sur la table du salon.
sujets.prompt: A white board with brass nails installed on a kraft box stand on a living room table, half-woven black thread portrait visible as abstract lines, a cup of coffee, a phone on a wooden stand, cushions with Algerian embroidery, evening lamp light.

sujets.brief: Un cadeau de couple : votre histoire, fil après fil.
sujets.prompt: A young Algerian couple hanging the reference circular string art portrait together on the wall of their new apartment, laughing, cardboard moving boxes in the background, warm light. Keep the portrait exactly as in the reference image.

sujets.brief: Le portrait du grand-père, pour garder sa mémoire dans la maison familiale.
sujets.prompt: A family gathering in a traditional Algerian home, grandchildren looking at the reference circular string art portrait of their grandfather hanging on the wall, a tea tray with a teapot on a low table, warm nostalgic light. Keep the portrait exactly as in the reference image.
